title: The more stressful waking life is, the more active my mallworld dreams are.
content: My depression has come back full force recently and my waking life demands are constant. I’m a therapist part time and a full-time parent and waking up lately just feels like “ah fuck, I’m back here again” The last time my mallworld dreams were this intense was a few years ago when my depression was just as severe. My mallworld feels peaceful these days compared to waking life. Does anyone else feel like this? Like you’d prefer to just be asleep at all times in mallworld at the water park, the hotel with the glass windows or the beach. I should probably talk to someone haha.
